Name: PPJA - Legacy Sprites
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: A collection of legacy sprites for items previously added by PPJA that were added in game updates.
Description:
![](https://i.imgur.com/DwFK8Ni.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/asuQXFm.png)

- A collection of all of the legacy PPJA sprites for items that have been added to the vanilla game
- Each object is toggleable. Default is false.

Includes:

*   Banana

*   Banana Pudding

*   Dragon Tooth

*   Ginger (Object)

*   Ginger Ale

*   Green Tea

*   Mango

*   Pina Colada

*   Pineapple

*   Rice (Crop)

*   Taro

*   Tea Leaf
![](https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png)

- Latest version of [SMAPI](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI)
- Latest version of [Content Patcher
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)
- Latest version of [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) (optional, allows you to edit config's on the title screen)

![](https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png)﻿

Step 1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There is 1 file included in the download:

[CP] PPJA Legacy Sprites

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

﻿![](https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png)

- Remove the [CP] PPJA Legacy Sprites folder

Downloads.Description:
If you're using the old Fruits and Veggies legacy sprites, remove that mod before installing this as it includes them.
Everything defaults to false.

Drag + Drop into `Mods`
